constraints.statement: Java 8 source/target bytecode; minimum runtime Android 5.0 (API 21), checked with animal-sniffer android-api-level-21 on every Android-targeted module.
Core public API must not use java.nio.file.*, CompletableFuture, java.net.http.*, android.*, javax/jakarta.servlet.* or force the Kotlin stdlib.
Build only with the Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper; the root build.gradle configures every module and modules carry no build files of their own.

Every callback is a @FunctionalInterface; public API uses Express-style short names, no Kotlin keywords as method names, value objects follow getX/setX, nullability via @Nullable with the @NullMarked default.
Public API changes update docs/api/ in the same change, with the Express counterpart and Java and Kotlin examples; unnamed items are decided during implementation and recorded.
Behaviour changes follow TDD: a failing test citing the requirement before implementation, never weakening tests.
Never run git add -A or git commit -a; commits stage explicit pathspecs; the integration branch is never merged into main by the run.
